observations.creation_time: Session row is not created on launch; it is created only when the first prompt is sent (or injected)
observations.disambiguation: Redirecting devpass-code's stderr to a unique, per-tmux-pane file (e.g. 2> /tmp/stderr.log) allows the relay to parse exactly `message=created id=ses_XYZ` emitted exclusively by that specific devpass-code process. Foreign rows created concurrently will not be written to this file.
observations.resume: On exact-id resume, the ID is already known and explicitly passed via `--session <id>`; no discovery is needed.
